prompt:
12-second portrait gameplay explainer for Bird Sort 2 Color Puzzle Game. Use the supplied image as the exact first frame. Preserve this same game's enhanced art, seven branch rows, every bird identity, board geometry and full UI. One continuous locked view, no cuts or crop.
Rows count from the top; L/R mean left/right branches. A move transfers matching birds at the open end to the same type or an empty branch, capacity five. Right-branch open ends face the center.
0–1.5s: hold the board; the existing hand selects the inner blue-yellow macaw on R3.
1.5–4.5s: tap L4; exactly that macaw flies onto its matching macaw. L4 grows from four to five mixed birds; it does NOT clear.
4.5–7.5s: select R3 again and tap L1. Its now-exposed orange-crested bird flies onto L1's matching end; L1 grows from three to four birds.
7.5–10.5s: select R3, then empty R4. Its two now-exposed red-yellow birds fly together to R4. R3 retains its far macaw; R4 now holds two birds.
10.5–12s: settle and hold. All unrelated birds stay put. No duplicates, disappearances, branch clear, score change, reward or victory.
Strong readable game feel: tap rings and selected-bird rims, elastic takeoff, wingbeats, short color trails, tiny branch flex and crisp squash landings with compact sparkles. Effects clear quickly; never hide the birds or their paths. Sync soft clicks, wing whooshes and progressively brighter landing chirps. Warm playful music stays below clear English narration, exactly: "Tap a branch, then move its end birds onto matching birds—or an empty branch." No added subtitles. Keep the download icon and all seven rows visible.
